scope: Fugle API-key secure storage, replacement and revocation boundary
behavior: The Fugle key uses a dedicated Android secure-storage namespace and versioned slot
Only configured state is displayed; a stored key is never read back into or echoed by the UI
The input is obscured, disables suggestions/autocorrect and is cleared after save, revoke and disposal
Empty, whitespace-containing and oversized keys are rejected before storage
Replacing and revoking the local key are explicit operations
The manager supplies the key only to the injected Fugle API-key source
Existing Android cloud-backup and device-transfer rules exclude all shared preferences
